detectorChanges:
All new rules are general (openings.py, geomkit.py; docstring rules 4-7):

1. Glazing in a gap that is one side of an all-glass corridor, where the gap is not cap-end, is a glass wall (upper-042 removed).
2. A pocket line counts only if at least 80 % of its part past the gap lies inside wall (upper-045 removed; presidential D7 kept).
3. A symbol door's chord turns onto the nearest wall-face direction, at most 10 degrees (upper-048, now upper-043, straightened; ground-037/038/039 and L2-028 also straightened).
4. A symbol door with no wall, jamb or glazing bound, whose leaf closes against a single wall-layer line drawn unbroken through the chord, is dropped (upper-050 removed).
5. Glass from a cross wall's side round a post-less glass corner is a glass enclosure (upper-058 removed).
6. A gap measured from a block shorter than it is thick, with glazing outside the block, puts the window on the glazing's line (ground-030 to x 8.848; UW-01 on its sashes).
7. New layer role 'screen' (Sukhumvit A_Grill and W_Grill moved there; the per-drawing config is still layer roles only). Screen lines close a gap and are never low-wall faces, so the grille-only service-yard windows are gone (optional keys).

11. Optional mapping 'areas' (not used by the four mappings).
